question: The lower house of the state legislature is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidhan Sabha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The lower house of the state legislature is also known as the State Assembly or Vidhan Sabha.**
 
• It is responsible for making **laws and policies** at the **state **level.
 
• The Vidhan Sabha is composed of elected** **representatives from various constituencies in the state.
 
• The term of Vidhan Sabha is usually **5 years**, unless dissolved earlier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vidhan Parishad is the upper house of the state legislature, also known as the Legislative Council.**

 
 
• **It is a permanent body with one-third of its members retiring every two years.**
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha** is the** lower house** of the Indian Parliament, responsible for making laws and policies at the** national** level.
 
• **Rajya Sabha** is the** upper house** of the Indian Parliament, also responsible for making laws and policies at the** national **level.
 
 
• **It is a permanent body with one-third of its members retiring every two years.**
